text: I’m Misty Kendall. I’m a qualified candidate for the Santee School District Seat 1 and am endorsed by the Santee Teachers Association.

My qualifications: Santee School District’s District Advisory Committee (past two years); Santee School District’s Budget Advisory Committee (past two years); final round candidate for vacated school board seat when Ken Fox chose to resign; Cub Scout Pack Committee Chair (past seven years); BA in political science from Houghton College; USD paralegal graduate; and legal assistant (past nineteen years) formerly at a law firm downtown and currently with a local tribal government.
The Santee School District was a major draw for my family to move to Santee eleven years ago. My three kids have attended school within the district since they started kindergarten.

I have a vested interest in the success of the district, for my children and for our whole community. I grew up in East County and attended public schools within the La Mesa Spring Valley School District and Grossmont Union High School District.

I'm a product of public education and believe in the public school system. I will do right by the students, parents, teachers, administrators, and community. Communication and compassion are keys to working together to make the district the best that it can be. I look forward to serving our community. Thank you.

text: Cindy Petretta is a dedicated mother and youth advocate running for the School Board in order to represent Santee families and ensure that our schools remain safe, transparent and student-focused. Born here in East County, and a 28-year resident of Santee, Cindy has a strong understanding of the needs of locals. Both of her children attended Santee schools, where Cindy volunteered in classrooms, afterschool clubs and Girl Scouts. Being a single parent has given Cindy a strong sense of financial responsibility and determination. Professionally, she has been directing a children’s department at a nonprofit for over a decade, before that she was a preschool teacher, and previously worked almost 20 years in the fields of Security and Community Relations.

If elected, her focus will be on continual improvement of safety and transparency in our schools. Children deserve a childhood and an excellent education, and every parent deserves a seat at the table. Cindy respectfully asks for your vote to represent the voice of Santee parents and taxpayers.
